dispositions.evidence: r4 repair (user decision "Conservative + escalate"): verdicts are three-valued. supported only when value+unit/currency/range+bound noun, every entity and polarity are unambiguous; contradicted on clear opposite evidence (scoped polarity, zero/without, opposite verbs); otherwise needs_review naming the figure/entity/polarity; unsupported when no quote shares a name, figure or enough words. strict exits 1 on contradicted and unsupported/uncited factual claims, lists needs_review (review_required, needs_review[], stderr count, report section). Fixed r4 bugs: range parsing ("and" joins number words only in a compound; ranges tagged lo/hi), currency set (yen/yuan/RMB/rupee/franc/A$/C$/HK$/S$/NZ$/codes/words; stated claim currency must appear in quote), year binding (opener segments merge forward; year must co-occur with the claim's other figures), metric binding (verbs of change dropped; nearest metric word required), "not even" is a negation, scoped negation ("A supports X and B does not", "with no X", "X, not Y", idioms), role swap/voice ambiguity, negated fragments, short evaluative sentences ("Pricing is simple") are not claims while counts ("7 days") and names are. Corpus verdict counts: {"verbatim r1-r3": {"F": {"supported": 0, "contradicted": 17, "needs_review": 36, "unsupported": 2}, "H": {"supported": 49, "contradicted": 0, "needs_review": 1, "unsupported": 0}}, "r4 verbatim": {"F": {"supported": 0, "contradicted": 2, "needs_review": 34, "unsupported": 0}, "H": {"supported": 64, "contradicted": 0, "needs_review": 5, "unsupported": 0}}, "curated": {"F": {"supported": 0, "contradicted": 14, "needs_review": 30, "unsupported": 1}, "H": {"supported": 45, "contradicted": 0, "needs_review": 0, "unsupported": 0}}, "held-out": {"F": {"supported": 0, "contradicted": 11, "needs_review": 21, "unsupported": 0}, "H": {"supported": 32, "contradicted": 0, "needs_review": 0, "unsupported": 0}}}
dispositions.notes: needs_review is not a pass: documented resolve workflow (quote the exact supporting span as evidence, or correct/remove the claim) in SKILL.md and reference/quality-gates.md. Fabrication probes (r1-r4 verbatim, curated, held-out): 0 supported; 3 are unsupported (unrelated quote) which strict fails; honest probes: 0 contradicted/unsupported, 6 of 119 verbatim honest need review (passive/active voice, ", not X," parenthetical, negation reach in a coordinated claim, noun paraphrase of a metric).
